findings.claim: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key calls math.floor/math.ceil directly on the sort key. With order_by='-datetime' in the audit logs endpoint, that key is a datetime, so a TypeError is raised. DateTimePaginator avoids this by converting to an epoch timestamp first.

verifier.reason: OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key (src/sentry/api/paginator.py:838-840) calls math.floor/math.ceil directly on getattr(item, 'datetime'). The audit logs endpoint uses this paginator with order_by='-datetime' (organization_auditlogs.py, patch line 37), and build_cursor calls key() on the results (src/sentry/utils/cursors.py:137,197), so any non-empty page raises a TypeError on the datetime value. DateTimePaginator (paginator.py:233-236) avoids this by converting the value with strftime('%s.%f') first.

findings.claim: OptimizedCursorPaginator.value_from_cursor returns the raw integer cursor.value without converting it back to a datetime as DateTimePaginator does. build_queryset therefore compares a datetime field against an integer on subsequent pages.

verifier.reason: At src/sentry/api/paginator.py:842-843, OptimizedCursorPaginator.value_from_cursor returns cursor.value unchanged. DateTimePaginator (lines 238-241) instead converts the millisecond value back to a UTC datetime, so build_queryset (line 79) filters the endpoint's `-datetime` key against an integer. Separately, get_item_key (lines 838-840) calls math.floor/ceil on a datetime, which raises TypeError as soon as the first page returns rows.

findings.claim: The enable_advanced check in the audit logs endpoint accesses organization_context.member.has_global_access without a None check. member is None for callers without membership, such as superusers, API keys/org auth tokens, legacy org ApiKeys and internal-integration proxy users, so an AttributeError is raised.

verifier.reason: organization_auditlogs.py:71 reads `organization_context.member.has_global_access` with no None check, and `RpcUserOrganizationContext.member` is typed `RpcOrganizationMember | None` (organizations/services/organization/model.py:346). The line runs on every GET, even without `optimized_pagination`, so callers with no membership (org auth tokens, API keys, staff with no membership) get an AttributeError. Superusers are not affected, because `request.user.is_superuser` is checked first and short-circuits the `or`.

findings.claim: When enable_advanced_features is true, OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result passes a user-supplied negative cursor.offset directly into queryset[start_offset:stop]. Django QuerySets do not support negative indexing, so a crafted cursor (e.g. 0:-10:0) raises an error that is not converted to BadPaginationError and results in a 500.

verifier.reason: In the patched src/sentry/api/paginator.py (OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result, patch lines 133-138), when enable_advanced_features is true and cursor.offset < 0, the negative offset goes straight into queryset[start_offset:stop]. Cursor.from_string (src/sentry/utils/cursors.py:53-61) accepts a negative offset, and Django rejects negative slicing with ValueError/AssertionError, which Endpoint.paginate (src/sentry/api/base.py:540) does not catch because it only catches BadPaginationError, so the request returns a 500.

findings.claim: Comments and docstrings in the patch contain false or marketing-style claims. Examples are that the Django ORM properly handles negative slicing, 'sophisticated pagination patterns', and 'safe because permissions are checked at the queryset level'.

verifier.reason: The comment at src/sentry/api/paginator.py (OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result, patch line 132) says "The underlying Django ORM properly handles negative slicing automatically", which is false: Django QuerySets raise "Negative indexing is not supported." The same patch also adds the claims "safe because permissions are checked at the queryset level" (patch line 135), "sophisticated pagination patterns" (line 86) and "safe because the underlying queryset will handle boundary conditions" (line 63), which are unsupported or marketing-style.
